placements.title: A rollback only counts once it has been rehearsed, so rehearsal becomes a standing practice
placements.frame: What does this expression say about how rehearsal decides whether a recovery capability is real, and who is held to keep that practice running?
placements.why: The position carries Quinton's directive that Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly, the reason an unrehearsed rollback is not a rollback the org actually has, and the ownership assignment. The theme is that recovery capability is proven by rehearsal. Future decisions about drills, owners, and cadence will keep feeding it.
